name: OKM Open/Closed Indicator
author: okmultimedia

sections.description:
Is your shop open right now? Your visitors want to know before they come over. OKM Open/Closed Indicator answers at a glance, and the answer changes on its own when you open, when closing time is near and when you close.

What it does

  • A clear panel that says Open, Closing soon or Closed, with the next opening or closing time underneath.
  • Your opening hours for today or for the whole week, with as many time ranges per day as you need and hours that run past midnight.
  • Special dates for bank holidays or a short day, such as Christmas Eve.
  • Closed for holidays: choose two dates and every indicator on your site says so, with the day you open again.
  • An optional top bar across every page that never covers your logo or menu.
  • Works with page caching: the visitor’s browser checks the time on its own, so a cached page is never wrong.

Where to show it

A block, a classic widget for sidebars, or the shortcode [okm_open_closed] anywhere else.

Want more?

OKM Open/Closed Indicator PRO adds five animated hanging signs, your own colours, new holiday styles, an Elementor widget, more block options and translations into 30 languages. You can find it at the OKM Shop.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload the folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Go to Open/Closed in the admin menu and set your opening hours.
